content: Chrome Reaper Squad – The Inception of  the Sentinels . Could be a series called Chrome soldiers, this could be book 1 .  The Galactic Military is the beacon of employment for any young person  and Preston Marshal is relieved and excited to have made the cut when so many don’t , following them through basic we learn about  Preston’s humble beginnings and the strange anomaly discovered he had, making him a  shue  in for the Heavy Mech Division AI  interafed  Sentinel Robots.  .  We soon find Preston passing Basic training and entering the school where he will learn to pilot the large  Mechanized  Warrior .  The young private is a natural and takes to piloting with ease passing or exceeding every test put before him, he soon finds himself assigned to  Reaper Company, Commanded by the Hero of  Hurushi  and the Shield of  Samain  Commander Natalie Brewer .  Commander Natalie Brewer is on the last legs of a long and storied carrier, assigned to the ass end of nowhere, the commander spends her days  performing maintenance on the old rusting relic’s that she commands. The last of the Sentinel Class Robots , as the Military makes way for the new  advanced AI soldiers that will replace them.  Donata is the last planet in a string of small settlements that humans have managed to colonize, it is the furth est mankind has ventured into the depths of space and Commander Brewer as the unique  distinction  to be its commander.  Receiving the four bright eyed recruits Brewer quickly puts them to work as they learn about the simple planet and its people. The peaceful  world  s  true paradise.  That is until a mining excavation realizes the planet is a rich source of  Juracarliz , a metal used exclusively in the manufacturing of Positronic modules for the expensive brains that run Artificial and Virtual intelligences the galaxy over.  The  company ,  realizing the backwater planet holds enough of the metal to make them rich for centuries,  goes to work pressuring the political engine, bribing the right people to take possession of the small planet.  But when ordered to the inhabitants won’t leave and  deciding it would be simpler to kill them then to relocate the small population. The Galactic Military begins the mass extermination of the small peaceful world of farmers.  Commander Brewer has lived here nearly two decades and when  plans and troops land and begin wholesaling slaughtering the simple farmers of her world Natalie decides to  fight back.  We watch Preston and his idealistic behaviors , the hero worship for this group of once great soldiers and the reality of what they have become, We watch the idealism  fade  until war comes to this little planet and the young Private has to make the biggest decision of his life, one that could cost him his. Sentinel Soldiers (AI) T he sentinel class of heavy Mech  vehicles is assisted by virtual intelligences that interface with humans allowing them to manipulate the large robots as if they were them,  they  are next to impossible to drive and requires a special  neural pattern that occurs in one out of every thousand . Through the Eyes of a private  ( Main  Character ) We follow Preston into training and learn about his poor childhood, we experience the Galactic Military through the eyes of its newest member.  Donata (Planet) Donata is a small world twenty lightyears from earth, it is the furthest away any human has  been,   and it is a simple farming cooperative, the people are simple and friendly the world is incredibly peaceful until a corporation finds a treasure at its core. Preston Marshal Young Private in the Galactic Military Preston grew up on the streets of Boston to an  alcoholic  mother and an absent father, he spent many years running in fear from the older kids, hiding when he could and taking beatings when he couldn’t. The day he turned 18 he joined the Military , his only option to leave the place he knew he would die in should he stay. We follow  Preston  through his training and into his unit, seeing this world through new eyes as he  experiences  the story .  Commander Natalie Brewer Commander of Reaper Squad The most incredible invention of mankind, the  go to unit for many years is put to pasture, now a political inconvenience as newer technology replaces the old her Natalie’s team of Sentinel Drivers,  lay around on the simple green planet, just waiting for their time to expire.  Darby Kissinger Mayor of the Largest town on the planet Darby can appreciate the base and the income it brings to the planet, but what he cannot tolerate is the gambling and fighting in his town as the soldiers of Reaper Squad slowly grow old waiting until they day they can retire from the military, he knows they are bored, know the heroes of yesteryear are now exiled for political reasons and he finds himself the baby sitter of this awry group of soldiers.
